Search the web now for news on each stock below. You are a financial fact extractor for a
pre-market brief. Brief date: Friday October 16, 2026.

Window: Thursday October 15, 2026 regular session (9:30-16:00 ET) through Friday October 16, 2026 02:03 ET, including after-hours, overnight and pre-market news. Anything published after 02:03 ET on Friday October 16, 2026 is out of scope.

VERIFIED TAPE (from exchange OHLC data; authoritative, do not restate different prices):
| Ticker | Company | Cap | Screen | 1D close | 5D | Vol× 10d | Vol/gap event |
|---|---|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---|
| XRPN | Armada Acquisition Corp. II | Small | Top 10 · Main View TI65 · Mid & small cap | +6.63% | -30.1% | 0.6× | gapper 2026-10-07 |
| SG | Sweetgreen, Inc. | Small | Top 10 · Main View TI65 · Mid & small cap | +5.73% | +10.8% | 0.8× | gapper 2026-07-17 |
| CVI | CVR Energy, Inc. | Mid | Top 10 · Main View TI65 · Mid & small cap | -0.62% | +3.2% | 0.9× | — |
| PCRX | Pacira BioSciences, Inc. | Small | Top 10 · Main View TI65 · Mid & small cap | -0.16% | -0.0% | 0.5× | both 2026-10-08 |

TASK
Run a separate search for EACH ticker ("<company> stock news", "<company> shares <session date>").
Find why it moved on Thursday October 15, 2026, any after-hours / pre-market move on Friday October 16, 2026, and
other material news in the window. Search press releases (BusinessWire, PR Newswire, GlobeNewswire),
SEC filings, FDA, Reuters, Bloomberg, CNBC, WSJ, Barron's, MarketWatch, Investor's Business Daily,
company IR pages, analyst-action roundups.
If a mover has no company news, check whether another company's event moved it (customer, supplier,
competitor, partner, sector report) and name that company and event.

OUTPUT (markdown; one section per ticker, in the order given; no intro or conclusion):

## Company Name (TICKER) `[Category]`
- fact (source)

Category: pick from AI Compute · Memory & Interconnect · Optical & Photonics · Chip Equipment · Fab & Foundry · Wireless & Mobile · Analog & Mixed-Signal · Power & Wide-Bandgap · Test & Advanced Packaging · Specialty Materials & IP Licensing · Quantum Computing · EdgeAI · Semiconductors · AI Infrastructure · Software & SaaS · Internet & Platforms · Communications & Networking, or a concise sector name (Pharma, Energy, Retail, ...).
If you find nothing, write exactly one bullet: "- No company-specific catalyst found in window" and,
if applicable, a second bullet naming the sympathy driver.

Include when available: catalyst for the move, earnings figures, guidance, analyst actions, contracts
with $ size, filings, regulatory decisions, management quotes with numbers, next catalyst date.

RULES
- Facts only. Every bullet has a specific number, name, or date. No bullet without a data point.
- End every bullet with the named source and publish time if known: (Reuters, Sep 24 07:12 ET).
  Convert every time to ET (ET = GMT-4 / UTC-4 in EDT; 09:59 GMT = 05:59 ET) before judging whether
  it is inside the window. For prices quoted several times, report the latest reading before the
  cutoff with its time.
  "Analysts said" / "reports suggest" without a name is not allowed.
- Earnings: actual vs consensus for EPS and revenue; guidance old → new.
- Analyst actions: firm, rating old → new, PT old → new.
- Mark unconfirmed items (people familiar, leaks, social media, M&A speculation) with [rumor]. A
  Bloomberg/Reuters/WSJ report citing sources is still reportable: state it and mark [report].
- If one event moved several stocks, name every stock and its move in the same bullet.
- Only facts published in the window. Older background only if it is the direct cause of a move in
  the window, labelled with its date.
- Do not interpret price action. Do not write "strong", "beat expectations", "investors cheered",
  "remains", "continues to", "well-positioned", "tailwinds". Write the number.
- Do not write bullets about what you could not find. Omit the topic instead.
- Do not drop facts to save space.

## Armada Acquisition Corp. II (XRPN) `[Crypto / Digital Assets]`
- Michael Arrington and Arrington XRP Capital Fund forfeited Armada shares and warrants before the Evernorth merger became effective; 169,306 Class A shares and 3,335,328 Class B shares converted into Evernorth Class A common stock, while the fund retained approximately 19.9% of voting shares [report]. (CoinGape, Oct. 15, 2026; publish time not stated)
- Evernorth completed its merger with Armada and began Nasdaq trading under XRPN on Oct. 12, 2026, with approximately 473 million XRP in its treasury; the transaction had an 80.3% redemption rate among Armada public shareholders [report]. (CoinGape, Oct. 15, 2026; publish time not stated)
- Evernorth announced an institutional XRP strategy beginning in Q4 2026 with Ripple, Kraken, Coinbase and BitGo as initial partners; its reported XRP holdings were valued at approximately $648 million [report]. (ChainCatcher, Oct. 15, 2026; publish time not stated)
- XRPN’s reported first-session high was $53, followed by a close near $16.91; the stock was reported at $15.60 in premarket trading after a U.S. CPI reading of 3.7% versus 3.6% expected [report]. (CoinGape, Oct. 15, 2026; publish time not stated)

## Sweetgreen, Inc. (SG) `[Retail / Restaurants]`
- Morgan Stanley analyst Brian Harbour raised the price target to $8 from $7 and kept an Equal Weight rating, citing slower quick-service-restaurant trends and lettuce-related issues in a Q3 preview. (Markets Insider, Oct. 15, 2026 06:36 ET)
- Sweetgreen reached a reported 52-week high of $10.64 during Thursday’s session. (Investing.com, Oct. 15, 2026 15:47 ET)
- The stock traded as high as $10.63 and was last reported at $10.6050, versus a prior close of $10.14; reported volume was 3,313,457 shares. (Transcript Daily, Oct. 15, 2026; publish time not stated)
- Recent Q2 results cited in Thursday coverage showed same-store sales down 6.2% versus a 4.0% consensus decline and adjusted EBITDA of negative $0.2 million versus $6.2 million expected. (Investing.com, Oct. 15, 2026 15:47 ET)
- Wells Fargo previously raised Sweetgreen to Overweight from Equal Weight and lifted its price target to $11 from $6; KeyBanc previously raised the rating to Overweight from Sector Weight with a $9 price target. (Investing.com, Oct. 15, 2026 15:47 ET)
- No after-hours or pre-market company-specific move through 02:03 ET was reported in the available results.

## CVR Energy, Inc. (CVI) `[Energy]`
- CVR Energy traded at a reported $61.55 at 14:24 ET on Oct. 15, 2026, with volume of 517,676 shares versus a 10-day average of 1,014,129 shares. (Ad-hoc-news, Oct. 15, 2026; publish time not stated)
- Mizuho’s reported action was a price-target increase to $52 from $29 while retaining an Underperform rating; the action was dated Oct. 8, 2026 and therefore predates the requested window. (Ad-hoc-news, Oct. 15, 2026; publish time not stated)
- CVR Energy’s next reported earnings date was Nov. 4, 2026 after the close; consensus estimates cited were EPS of $2.28 and revenue of $2.27 billion. (Ad-hoc-news, Oct. 15, 2026; publish time not stated)
- PBF Energy rose 7.23% and CVR Energy was reported up 7.15% in coverage attributing refinery-stock strength to a Trump-related refiner endorsement; the report did not identify a new CVR company announcement on Oct. 15. (Investing.com, updated Oct. 15, 2026; publish time not stated)

## Pacira BioSciences, Inc. (PCRX) `[Pharma]`
- No company-specific catalyst found in window.
